data_structures.dim_scalars: int32 ids for rt_actress, it_rd, cc_us, g_f
data_structures.Y_year_bitset: vector<uint64_t> sized (N_title+1) bits; bit mv set iff production_year[mv-1] > 2000 AND != INT32_MIN. ~316KB → L2-resident.
data_structures.P_fused_bitset: vector<uint64_t> sized (N_name+1) bits; bit pid set iff name[pid-1].gender=='f' AND memmem(name[pid-1],'An') AND an_off[pid+1] > an_off[pid]. ~520KB → L2-resident.

parallelism.morsel_unit: Y/P bitset builds: parallel for over rows. CSR scan: parallel for over k in [lo,hi) static schedule(4096). Main scan: parallel for over T static schedule(64). Per-thread local accumulators.

consumed only during P_fused_bitset build; not touched during main scan

scan_mi_csr_filter_order: 3. test Y bitset at mv — if NOT set, continue (skips varlen offset+data reads)
4. read mi_info_off[r], mi_info_off[r+1] and mi_info bytes
main_scan_filter_order: 1. mc range walk: require any cn_country_code[company_id-1]==cc_us; break on first hit
2. ci range walk: require role_id==rt_actress (cheap int compare)
4. pid = ci.person_id; require P_and_an bit set (single L2-resident bit test)
5. require ci.note voice-set (varlen, only for rare survivors)
6. update local MIN(name) and (once per movie) MIN(title)
optimization_notes: Root cause: scan_mi_csr_and_filter (26ms, 38% of total) wastes varlen offset+data reads on year-failing rows because LIKE check runs before the year filter; main_scan touches a 16MB aka_name offsets array per surviving ci row, exceeding LLC. Strategy: Category A+C (plan restructuring + work elimination). (1) Build a compact Y bitset over title.id (production_year > 2000 AND != INT32_MIN, ~316KB → L2). In the CSR scan, look up Y[mv] FIRST (after computing mv from mi_movie_id[r]); skip mi_info_off and mi_info_dat reads for rows whose movie fails the year filter — eliminates ~50% of varlen accesses, saving ~10-12ms. (2) Fuse three name-side filters into a single P_and_an bitset over name.id (gender='f' ∧ name LIKE '%An%' ∧ aka_name nonempty, ~520KB → L2). One bit test per ci row replaces a bit test + a separate 16MB cache-exceeding aka_name offsets random probe — should shave ~2-3ms from main_scan. Expected total: ~52-55ms vs 68ms baseline. No changes to threshold_constant 2000 (year cutoff preserved verbatim).
